Name: Coffee Restores More Energy (Content Patcher)
Author: CrystalShapeshifter
Description:
Coffee and Triple Shot Espresso restore more energy (and health, as the values are linked). Coffee now restores 38 energy and 17 health, Triple Shot Espresso restores 113 energy and 51 health. The speed buff and duration are the same. Only affects newly made Coffee/Triple Shot Espresso; if it was made before adding this mod, the values will be vanilla (I don't know why, don't ask me). 

Requires Content Patcher and Stardew 1.6. 1.5 version is archived.

I'll try and keep it updated, but I tend to stop playing Stardew for long periods of time; anyone is free to pick this up to keep it updated if I fall behind. 

Permissions: Don't sell it or put it behind a paywall, and follow Content Patcher's license. Otherwise, do as you wish with it.
